run_tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce: run tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce to all-reduce a tensor across the tensor-parallel group
run_tensor_model_parallel_all_gather: run tensor_model_parallel_all_gather to all-gather a tensor across the tensor-parallel group along a specified dimension
run_sequence_model_parallel_all_to_all_4: run sequence_model_parallel_all_to_all_4D to perform all-to-all communication on 4D tensors across the sequence-parallel group
run_cfg_model_parallel_all_gather: run cfg_model_parallel_all_gather to all-gather a tensor across the CFG parallel group with optional separate-tensors output
run_cfg_model_parallel_all_reduce: run cfg_model_parallel_all_reduce to all-reduce a tensor across the CFG parallel group with a specified reduce operation
